description_en: Creates a draft of a workflow template
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo create-workflow-template-draft-version --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --template-id tpl_9401 --biz-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWorkflowTemplateDraftVersion

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The version number to which the returned content belongs
parameters.help_zh: 本次返回内容所属的版本号
parameters.name: version

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

createdByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

description.example: 处理客户投诉的标准流程

edges.description_en: The node dependency edges. Each item contains a from and to field, referencing stable step IDs
edges.description_zh: 节点依赖边；每项包含from/to，引用稳定stepId

items.description_en: A node dependency edge. The from field indicates the step ID of the predecessor node, and the to field indicates the step ID of the successor node
items.description_zh: 一条节点依赖边，from为前置节点stepId，to为后置节点stepId

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current effective version number of the template. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists and it cannot be used for work items
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 模板当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿、不可用于工作项

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The modification time in ISO 8601 format

layout.description_en: The optional canvas layout, indexed by step ID. This field only affects the display and does not determine dependencies
layout.description_zh: 可选画布布局，按stepId索引；只影响展示，不决定依赖

name.description_en: The step name. This field can be left empty for a draft and is required upon submission
name.description_zh: 步骤名称；草稿可为空，提交时必填

schemaVersion.description_en: The schema version of the template. The current value is 2, which is independent of the business version vN
schemaVersion.description_zh: 模板结构版本，当前为2，与业务版本vN独立

items.example: {"modelMode":"standard","name":"客户投诉处理流程","ownerAgentName":"example","ownerType":"MEMBER","ownerUserId":1,"reviewOutput":false,"reviewerUserIds":[10086],"sortOrder":1,"specification":"收集客户信息，交给负责人审核","specificationJson":[{"type":"text","text":"收集客户信息"}],"stepId":"collect"}

name.description_en: The step name. This field can be left empty for a draft and is required upon submission
name.description_zh: 步骤名称；草稿可为空，提交时必填

ownerAgentName.description_en: The name of the agent owner

ownerType.description_en:
The owner type. Valid values:
MEMBER: Human.
AGENT: Agent
ownerType.description_zh: 负责人类型：MEMBER 人工 / AGENT 智能体

ownerUserId.description_en: The user ID of the human owner

reviewOutput.description_en: Specifies whether to manually review deliverables. By default, this feature is disabled. It can only be enabled for digital workers, and review tasks are automatically sent to the owner
reviewOutput.description_zh: 是否人工审核产出物，默认关闭；仅数字员工可开启，审核待办自动发负责人

reviewerUserIds.description_en: The list of reviewer user IDs

items.description_en: The list of reviewer user IDs

specification.description_en: The display text derived from ordered segments. Fixed titles are not added, and the text is not stored independently
specification.description_zh: 从有序片段派生的展示文本；不补固定标题，不独立存储
specification.example: 收集客户信息，交给负责人审核

specificationJson.description_en: The array of ordered segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. Reference identities and order are preserved
specificationJson.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

items.description_en: The array of ordered segments. Supported types include text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. Reference identities and order are preserved
items.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

version.description_en: The version number to which the returned content belongs
version.description_zh: 本次返回内容所属的版本号

versionDescription.description_en: The change description for this version. An empty value indicates that no description is provided
versionDescription.description_zh: 该版本的变更说明；为空表示未填写

versionStatus.description_en:
The version status. Valid values:
DRAFT: Draft.
SUBMITTED: Submitted
versionStatus.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交
